nodes.name: GDE Preparation via Catalyst Coating
nodes.procedure: The catalyst ink was prepared by sonicating a known amount of Vulcan XC72R (as received), Nafion solution, and PTFE dispersion in an isopropanol-water mixture for 30 min. The suspension was coated on the Sigracet 39BB using an airbrushing technique (ECL-4501 Eclipse HP-CS air sprayer, by Anest Iwata) by keeping the carbon paper on the hot plate at 50 °C. Using the abovementioned procedure, an electrode with a Vulcan carbon loading of 2 mgcm-2 was prepared.

nodes.name: Electrolyte Preparation
nodes.procedure: Preparation of 1.0 M KOH, 6.0 M KOH, and 3.0 M KOH solutions using Potassium hydroxide pellets and Deionized ultrapure water.
nodes.source_text: The electrolyte containing 1.0 M KOH flows... The 6.0 M KOH was recirculated... The membrane was conditioned in a boiling 3.0 M KOH solution... Deionized (DI) ultrapure water... was used for solution preparation.

nodes.name: Reactor Assembly
nodes.procedure: The cathode was assembled by placing the GDE on the stainless-steel mesh, with an additional layer of porous PTFE membrane on the back. Kapton tape attached the GDE assembly to the collector plate. The reactor was built by packing the GDE (cathode), membrane, and Ni foam (anode) with neoprene gaskets and teflon spacers between two rectangular stainless-steel blocks with a compression of 75 in.-lb.

unit_operations.name: Packing

nodes.description: Stability failure investigation in flow-by mode at high current density
nodes.source_text: under flow-by mode with a ΔP of 12.7 mbar at the electrode inlet, the FE reaches 97% after 10 min . However, after an hour of operation the FE dropped sharply, approaching nearly zero after 90 min

nodes.description: Performance restoration via flow-through mode after flooding
nodes.source_text: This switching from flow-by operation to flow-through mode restored the performance of the GDE, and the initial FE of 95–97% was observed... the cell voltage requirement surged from ~6.1 V under flow-by mode to ~7.6 V in flow-through along with severe voltage fluctuations (+/- 1.5 V)
